% A test for tex8web's page title in a document without \maketitle: the
% <title> and og:title come from \title, as \maketitle gives them, without
% its formatting or its \thanks.
\documentclass{article}
\title{Notes on \emph{Groups}\\ and Rings\thanks{A note on the title.}}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\section{A section}
Some text.
\end{document}
